Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form: Redwood Inference pilot — a few invoicing questions

Olivia — thanks for the PO and the clear list. Quick answers below; see inline and attached draft order form with the pricing table updated (OrderForm-draft-20260915.docx).

- Pricing / overages: monthly invoicing. Tier breakpoints are 0–5M tokens, 5–20M, 20M+. Overages are billed at the next tier rate, pro-rated by token. I put the exact per-token rates in the attached draft (Section B).

- Activation fee and minimum commit: we can apply the activation fee toward the first month of committed usage provided the customer executes the Order Form within 30 days of signature. Otherwise the activation fee is non-refundable.

- Net terms: standard for pilots is Net 30. For CoreHealth we can escalate to Net 45 with a small administrative surcharge (0.5% of monthly invoice) or with a 60-day invoice milestone cadence (we can discuss). Ben, /Karthik — please confirm if Legal is OK with Net 45 + surcharge or if we should accept Net 45 without surcharge for strategic reasons.

- Taxes & VAT evidence: Redwood will provide standard tax invoices and can supply VAT reverse-charge evidence for EU entities, but we need the billing entity mapping on your PO (which entity will receive invoices).

If you can confirm the billing entity and preferred Net 30 vs Net 45 by end of week, we will finalize and route to Legal for signature.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: OrderForm-draft-20260915.docx (stub)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Order Form: Redwood Inference pilot — a few invoicing questions

Looping in a couple of recommendations from Commercial / Legal:

Karthik and I discussed. Proposal to move the deal forward quickly:
- Accept Net 45 for CoreHealth but add a conditional clause: Net 45 w/o surcharge if PO is for the full minimum commit (6 months). If they want month-to-month pilot, apply Net 45 + 0.5% surcharge.
- For activation fee: allow it to apply to first invoice provided the Order Form has a payment remittance entity and PO number.
- On tax evidence: request that CoreHealth include the VAT registration for the EU entity on the PO; Redwood will append the reverse-charge statement to every EU invoice.

Also recommend we offer to split invoicing across entities only if we get confirmation on the legal entity and tax IDs — else stick to single invoice to the entity on the PO.

If OK, Kimberly — I can send a short redline to the Order Form with the Net 45 conditional language and the invoice-entity evidence clause.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
